jobs.title: Assembler
jobs.shift: Shift and hours shared at interview
jobs.about: Ambassador Personnel is hiring an Assembler in Norcross, GA. Pay is $17.00/hr, paid weekly.
jobs.duties:
Assemble parts and products by work instructions
Use hand and power tools to fit and fasten parts
Inspect work for quality and fix defects
Keep the work area clean and organized
jobs.reqs:
Able to follow written and verbal instructions
Good hand-eye coordination and attention to detail
Able to stand or sit for a full shift
